title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28213:20170726:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda to the Organization of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Institutions <Presidential Decree No. 28213, July 26, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Omitted.
(2) Part of the Decree on the Establishment of National Technical High Schools shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1), Article 4 (2) through (4), the part other than the subparagraphs of paragraph (5) of the same Article, Article 7 (2), and Article 10, "Administrator of the Small and Medium Business Administration" shall be replaced with "Minister of SMEs and Startups", respectively.
In Article 3, "Organization of the Small and Medium Business Administration and Its Affiliated Institutions" shall be replaced with "Organization of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and Its Affiliated Institutions".
In Article 8, "Small and Medium Business Administration" shall be replaced with "Ministry of SMEs and Startups".
(3) through (22) Omitted.
